test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Catch Cola 300 ML with MRP Rs. 20 is displayed in a Hyper Market with an Offer 'BUY 2 GET 1 FREE'. With this offer, the Hyper Market is giving what per cent discount?
solution:
Given:

An offer of “Buy 2 Get 1 free” is given.

Concepts used:

M.P. = S.P. + Discount

Discount % = Discount/M.P. × 100

Calculation:

Let M.P. of 1 good be Rs.x

M.P. of 3 goods = 3x

Discount on 3 goods = Rs. x

⇒ Discount on 1 good = Rs. x/3

⇒ Net discount % = {(x/3)/x} × 100 = 33.33%

∴ The net discount is equal to 33.33%.
